name: io.github.Contextator/contextator
title: Contextator
description: Self-hosted documentation server: each project's indexed docs as its own MCP endpoint.

host.description: Host (and port, if not 443) of your own Contextator deployment.

project.description: Name of the project to connect to, as it appears in the dashboard and in its MCP URL.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Only for a project in token mode: a static MCP token created on the project's page. A project in account mode signs in with OAuth instead, and an open project needs no header.
